Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up earlier prototype normal save, including 0024 through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. The returning Cerulean robbed-house and stolen Dig TM event are converted. Route 5 follows next. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Nugget Bridge trainers remain visible across the Cerulean boundary, including when loading an older normal save. The sign west of the south bridge entrance reads ROUTE 24 / NUGGET BRIDGE when you press A. Bill’s PC has a visible computer terminal at its existing interaction spot. After helping Bill, enter the robbed house, use the new rear-wall passage, and confront the Rocket with Machop and Drowzee at level 17. Winning returns reusable TM28 Dig; a full TM pocket permits a later retry without repeating the battle. Earlier features carry forward. Use Continue and keep a backup; emulator save states stay with their exact ROM version. Johto terrain and earlier patch pages remain unchanged.
